claude_proposed_widenings.name: stateful_item_form_mode
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item has persistent mutable forms, and later passive/reaction properties are gated by the current form. The existing magic-item surface has composite parts and alter_item_kind, but no way to store current item form and condition other mechanics on it.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding this weapon, you can take a Bonus Action to alter its form, turning it into a 6-inch rod ... or a 10-foot pole, or reverting it a Quarterstaff. In certain forms, the weapon has the following additional properties.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: emit_light
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item can be toggled to emit dim light, and the current surface has no light-emission effect atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can cause it to emit green Dim Light out to 10 feet ... or you can extinguish the light

claude_proposed_widenings.name: weapon_property_mutation_with_return
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item temporarily gains the Thrown property with explicit normal/long range and an immediate return-to-hand rider after a ranged attack. The current surface lacks an honest way to mutate weapon properties on the item and encode the return behavior.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This weapon has the Thrown property with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 120 feet. Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand.
